verdict.rationale: As a hosted API, TaxJar inherently applies current rates/rules server-side (client just calls the API), and features like economic nexus tracking and AutoFile imply the vendor manages ongoing compliance changes, but no evidence explicitly documents an automatic rate/rule update process, a changelog of when jurisdiction changes take effect, or an explicit no-redeploy guarantee. Missing for 10: explicit rate-update cadence/documentation, change notification or changelog for jurisdiction rule changes, and explicit no-redeploy assurance.
